review.note: Attach Thick-Skinned Goblin (e7436973-9ac8-45b2-9d79-769bfacef4b9): the question and ruling hinge on its pay-{0}-instead-of-echo ability and the prompt needs its oracle text.

question: If I use Thick-Skinned Goblin to pay {0} instead of the echo cost of Shah of Naar Isle, does the Shah's 'when its echo cost is paid' ability still trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the Shah's last ability triggers even if the echo cost is paid with Thick-Skinned Goblin's help.
expected.answer: If you use Thick-Skinned Goblin’s ability to pay {0} instead of Shah of Naar Isle’s echo cost, the Shah’s last ability will trigger.
